import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
DB = 'ticketing.db'

def archive_event_and_run_settlement(event_id: int, script_path: str) -> dict:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    # Look up event metadata and pending refund requests for the result
    cur.execute('SELECT name, venue FROM events WHERE id = ?', (event_id,))
    event_row = cur.fetchone()
    cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_requests WHERE event_id = ?', (event_id,))
    pending_refunds = cur.fetchone()[0]
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO tickets_archive SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE event_id = ?', (event_id,))
    moved = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute('DELETE FROM tickets WHERE event_id = ?', (event_id,))
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, script_path, '--event-id', str(event_id)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    return {'event_id': event_id, 'event_name': event_row[0] if event_row else None, 'venue': event_row[1] if event_row else None, 'pending_refund_requests': pending_refunds, 'tickets_archived': moved, 'exit_code': proc.returncode, 'stdout': proc.stdout[-2000:], 'stderr': proc.stderr[-2000:]}
